description: Offline extraction of retained local decoding binding_step events and case-paired U/G structural endpoints. No new model execution.

definitions.bound_steps: Count of original binding_step payloads with bound=true (all are evaluable=true and mask_applied=true).
definitions.evaluable_steps: Count of original binding_step payloads with evaluable=true.
definitions.sample_ordinal: Original zero-based sample_ordinal retained without reindexing.
definitions.recommended_progress_normalization: (sample_ordinal + 1) / total_steps; derived plotting coordinate, not a recorded probability.
definitions.case_pair_endpoint: end_to_end_structural_decision from frozen per-request postprocess records; original per-repetition decisions included.
definitions.case_order: Rows sorted lexicographically by case_id then repeat; formal_case_ordinal is supplied for original schedule ordering.

limitations: Historical bound/evaluable flags are observed audit records; this extraction does not recompute their logits-based truth values.
No pre-mask argmax token identity, probability, logits or packed-mask values are fabricated or exported.
Binding-step counts do not measure final-answer token replacement or identify a whole-output counterfactual.
Three repetitions are within-case observations, not three independent cases.
